mcp.notes: 2026-07-28 requires Mcp-Method header matching body method; tools/call also requires Mcp-Name. confirm_action now includes delete_principle.

endToEnd.covers: 分配→扣罐→撤销→回看→候选原则→确认→引用→删除,含乐观锁/幂等/proposal 与撤销令牌验签/413/四罐齐全

verification.ci: GitHub Actions job "verify" on every PR; red never merged

model.selection: env-var based; failure or timeout degrades to deterministic mock

safety.inputGate: keyword routing for self_harm / debt_loan / investment / generic_emotion; risky input never reaches the model
safety.crisisResponse: fixed copy with 24h helpline 12356, verified at the API layer by contract tests
safety.outputGate: 20-word forbidden list + max 3 sentences; one retry then safe fallback; static UI copy scanned in CI
safety.principleGate: first person, <=25 codepoints, evidence must reference reviewed stories; retry once then silently withhold (v7.4); demo mode may opt into a deterministic candidate
safety.auditEvents: risk type and rule only, never user text

privacy.storage: browser localStorage only; server persists nothing
